resources.string: Asks you to tap Start when someone wants to mirror this phone.
%1$s is waiting to view this phone. Tap to start, or ignore to decline.
Each session needs you to tap Start on the phone; mirroring can\'t run unattended. Turn on Remote control to let the viewer tap and type.
Secure windows (such as banking apps) are black in the stream, and on Android 15+ sensitive notifications are hidden while sharing. Audio shares the phone\'s media playback, not the microphone.
